rules.p95: Practical representative p95 and correctness; do not chase approximately3percent marginal gains.
rules.regressionTolerance: Working measurement rule: investigate repeatable input-queue p95 worsening exceeding max(2ms,10percent) under matched load. rules.repeatPolicy: Focused diagnostic before full replay; repeat only after a concrete correction, new failure or unexplained variance.
rules.evidenceReuse: Reuse only when relevant source/dependency/environment/workload inputs match; historical evidence is not final-tree sign-off.
rules.exceptions: Disclose inaccessible hardware GPU/VRAM/private-memory and protected/oversize cases. Physical-device or other required missing qualification is BLOCKED/UNTESTED, never PASS.
